comment.description: Your comment or reply (max 5000 characters). Add formatting using Markdown and formulas using LaTeX. For more information see https://openreview.net/faq

pdf.description: Upload a single page PDF file that ends with .pdf

instructions.description:
The main mission of the Authors Advocates (AA) is to ensure a fair review process. To that aim, the AA mediation can be requested **exclusively** for the following reasons related to factual errors:

- My submission received less than 3 reviews.
 - There might be a data entry error (e.g., the review is not for my submission).
- The reviewer asked to refer to/compare against a paper that is either unpublished (e.g., on arXiv) or is published after the MM'26 deadline.
- The review contains factual errors regarding your paper's contents that directly impacted the score.
- The reviewer's summary is copied directly from the paper's abstract.
- The review contains unprofessional, hostile, or dismissive language.

**For all other aspects** (internal contradictory statements, extreme ratings without justification, misunderstandings, lack of reviewer expertise), including scientific issues, **please address the Area Chair**. As a reminder, the Author Advocates will not attend any matters outside the list above, and will not reply to any e-mail.

The AA Mediation is a precious resource offered at ACM Multimedia. As such, it should be requested with care and in reasonable quantities (e.g. for the reasons listed above). **Any abuse of this resource could lead to the rejection of the paper at the discretion of the organisation committee of ACM Multimedia 2026.**
**Do not use the 'Official Comment' feature under the mediation request to detail your request.**
instructions.value: Read instructions above carefully before submitting.
